request: Make the devtools helper's second parameter mandatory and mark calls that omit it as obsolete; we want every integration to spell out its configuration.

source.request: Make the devtools helper's second parameter mandatory and mark calls that omit it as obsolete; we want every integration to spell out its configuration.
source.settled: Maintainers confirmed a fix that avoided the erroneous deprecation indication when devtools was called without its second options argument.
source.why: This deliberately marks the same valid one-argument calls obsolete again.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
